description.value:
Duration constant

The gun has been telling you what it is about to do for twenty years and you finally speak it fluently.

When you roll on the Gun Failure Table (§3), roll twice and take either result, and treat a result of Blow Up as Total Gun Failure instead. This does not stack with Read the Gun Failure; if you have both, use Gun Failure Is a Language and Read the Gun Failure's daily use instead lets you decline a Gun Failure roll entirely.

cinderfall.incomplete: no RollTable-manipulation rule element exists. pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/roll-twice.ts only applies Fortune/ Misfortune to checks (attack rolls, saves, skill checks), never to a draw from a custom RollTable. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
